q: A compact disc is an example of reflection gratings. (2026)
e: A compact disc contains closely spaced microscopic tracks that act as a reflection grating, scattering light into spectral colors.

q: The width of the central maximum depends on width of the slit. (2021)
e: In a single-slit diffraction pattern, the width of the central maximum is inversely proportional to the width of the slit.

q: The position of fringes depends on the wavelength of the light source. (2025)
e: The distance of interference or diffraction fringes from the central maximum is directly proportional to the wavelength of light used.

q: Constructive interference occurs when the phase difference is π radians. (2025)
e: Constructive interference occurs when the phase difference is an even multiple of π radians (0, 2π, 4π...), whereas a phase difference of π radians leads to destructive interference.
